name: Refresh Espansr Linux
description: Bash snippet that fetches origin, asks what to do with uncommitted work (commit, stash and restore, or abort), fast-forwards or rebases main, rebases a feature branch onto its remote copy and onto main, then pushes, publishes, or merges into main as you answer, restores stashed work, and reinstalls espansr.
content:
refresh_espansr() {
  remote_name="origin"
  main_branch="$(git symbolic-ref --quiet --short "refs/remotes/$remote_name/HEAD" 2>/dev/null | sed "s#^$remote_name/##")"
  [ -n "$main_branch" ] || main_branch="main"

  branch="$(git branch --show-current)" || return 1
  if [ -z "$branch" ]; then
    echo "Not on a branch."
    return 1
  fi

  ask() {
    printf '%s ' "$1" >&2
    read -r reply
    [ -n "$reply" ] || reply="$2"
    printf '%s\n' "$reply"
  }

  confirm() {
    while :; do
      case "$(ask "$1 [$2]" "$2")" in
        [Yy]*) return 0 ;;
        [Nn]*) return 1 ;;
      esac
      echo "Please answer y or n." >&2
    done
  }

  stashed=0
  restore_stash() {
    [ "$stashed" -eq 1 ] || return 0
    stashed=0
    if git stash pop; then
      echo "Restored your uncommitted changes."
    else
      echo "Stash restore stopped. Resolve conflicts before continuing; the stash was kept as stash@{0}."
      return 1
    fi
  }

  rebase_stopped() {
    echo "Rebase stopped on conflicts."
    if confirm "Abort the rebase and put everything back? (n leaves it for you to resolve)" y; then
      git rebase --abort
      restore_stash
      echo "Rebase aborted; nothing was pushed or reinstalled."
    else
      echo "Resolve the conflicts, run git rebase --continue, then run this command again."
      [ "$stashed" -eq 1 ] && echo "Your uncommitted changes are in stash@{0}; pop them afterwards."
    fi
    return 1
  }

  update_main() {
    git switch "$main_branch" || return 1
    if ! git merge --ff-only "$remote_name/$main_branch"; then
      echo "$main_branch cannot be fast-forwarded from $remote_name/$main_branch. Resolve $main_branch manually, then retry."
      return 1
    fi
  }

  reinstall_espansr() {
    if command -v espansr >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "Reinstalling espansr with 'espansr refresh'..."
      espansr refresh
    elif [ -f ./install.sh ]; then
      echo "espansr is not on PATH; running ./install.sh..."
      ./install.sh
    else
      echo "espansr is not installed and there is no install.sh here; reinstall skipped."
      return 1
    fi
  }

  echo "Fetching $remote_name..."
  if ! git fetch --prune "$remote_name"; then
    echo "Could not fetch $remote_name (offline?)."
    if confirm "Skip the update and only reinstall espansr?" n; then
      reinstall_espansr
      return $?
    fi
    return 1
  fi
  if ! git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/$remote_name/$main_branch"; then
    echo "Remote $remote_name/$main_branch was not found."
    return 1
  fi

  if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
    git status --short
    case "$(ask "Uncommitted changes: [c]ommit them, [s]tash and restore them after the update, or [a]bort?" s)" in
      [Cc]*)
        if [ "$branch" = "$main_branch" ]; then
          work_branch="work/refresh-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
          echo "Local changes are on main; moving them to $work_branch before updating main."
          git switch -c "$work_branch" || return 1
          branch="$work_branch"
        fi
        git add -A || return 1
        git commit -m "$(ask "Commit message:" "chore: sync local changes")" || return 1
        ;;
      [Aa]*)
        echo "Aborted; nothing changed."
        return 1
        ;;
      *)
        git stash push -u -m "refresh-espansr" || return 1
        stashed=1
        ;;
    esac
  fi

  if [ "$branch" = "$main_branch" ]; then
    echo "Updating $main_branch from $remote_name/$main_branch..."
    if ! git merge --ff-only "$remote_name/$main_branch"; then
      echo "$main_branch has local commits; rebasing them onto $remote_name/$main_branch."
      if ! git rebase "$remote_name/$main_branch"; then
        rebase_stopped
        return 1
      fi
    fi
    ahead="$(git rev-list --count "$remote_name/$main_branch..HEAD")"
    if [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ] && confirm "Push $ahead local commit(s) to $remote_name/$main_branch?" y; then
      git push "$remote_name" "$main_branch" || return 1
    fi
  else
    if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/$remote_name/$branch"; then
      echo "Updating $branch from $remote_name/$branch..."
      if ! git rebase "$remote_name/$branch"; then
        rebase_stopped
        return 1
      fi
    fi
    echo "Updating $main_branch from $remote_name/$main_branch..."
    if ! update_main; then
      git switch "$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1
      restore_stash
      return 1
    fi
    git switch "$branch" || return 1
    echo "Rebasing $branch onto $main_branch..."
    if ! git rebase "$main_branch"; then
      rebase_stopped
      return 1
    fi
    if confirm "Merge $branch into $main_branch and push $main_branch?" n; then
      git switch "$main_branch" || return 1
      git merge --no-ff "$branch" -m "Merge $branch" || return 1
      git push "$remote_name" "$main_branch" || return 1
      if confirm "Delete $branch locally and on $remote_name?" n; then
        git branch -d "$branch" || return 1
        if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/$remote_name/$branch"; then
          git push "$remote_name" --delete "$branch" || return 1
        fi
      fi
      branch="$main_branch"
    elif git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/$remote_name/$branch"; then
      if confirm "Push $branch to $remote_name (force-with-lease, since it was rebased)?" y; then
        git push --force-with-lease "$remote_name" "$branch" || return 1
      fi
    elif confirm "Publish $branch to $remote_name?" y; then
      git push --set-upstream "$remote_name" "$branch" || return 1
    fi
  fi

  restore_stash || return 1

  if confirm "Reinstall espansr now?" y; then
    reinstall_espansr || return 1
  fi
  git status -sb | head -n 1
}

refresh_espansr
